s01-title: Video nineteen: attendance, payroll, and one journal entry in the ledger.
s02-app: The HRM app is Tier zero, uses only the SPI, and adds eight new DocTypes. Frappe HRMS concept names, no code.
s03-components: Components: base pay, lunch and fuel allowances, a KPI bonus, and employee insurance. Rates are demo seed values.
s04-wasm: The courier bonus is tenant Wasm code in Rust, tiered by parcel count. Each save test-runs it. An infinite loop stops at fifty milliseconds and never reaches payroll.
s05-attendance: Attendance sets working days. A day with no record counts as worked: N V zero zero two has twenty-four point five.
s06-entry: Saving a Payroll Entry creates the draft slips: four in parallel, one virtual thread each, in one transaction.
s07-slip: N V zero zero two's slip traces every line: base pay by working days, KPI bonus from Wasm, insurance on contract salary. Net is gross minus insurance.
s08-submit: Submit commits the entry, slips and ledger in one transaction. One accrual entry for the period: debit six four two; credit insurance and three three four, payable to employees. It balances.
s09-guards: Three rejections. Cancel one slip, you cancel the entry. Rerunning September is blocked. Clients can't set pay.
s10-mcp: An AI agent asking about payroll over MCP sees masked names. It has the caller's permissions, so sales is refused.
s11-cancel: Cancel writes a reversing entry and deletes no rows. Payroll account balances return to zero, and the original history stays in the ledger.
s12-honest: To be accurate: a demo payroll app, not yet payroll software. Missing: personal income tax, salary payment, a month-end job, and employee self-service slips.
s99-recap: Recap: attendance sets working days, Wasm computes the bonus, four salary slips in one transaction, and one accrual entry. Next: STMS.
s10-outro: Astra. One platform, every business process. Open source, MIT license.
